text:
Sam W: Quick idea — UX panel called 'Fallback Inspector' that surfaces the chain of decisions when an automatic fallback/degrade happens. lightweight, single-pane view: rule matched, trigger reason, mode (soft-cache / quiet-reject / model-fallback), event ids + link to trace, and an option to 'replay' the request in dry-run mode.

Maya R: +1. Do we have stable event names for telemetry we can link? we shouldn't build UI without them. :thumbsup:

Oliver K: Love the visibility, but we need to be careful about what the audit stores. request bodies may contain PII. The Inspector should reference sampled_request_id and trace_id, not full payload unless customer opts in.

Carla L: UX nit: show a small timeline at top with 'Decision time' (ms), 'Latency spike' (if that's the trigger), and the model route before/after. Breadcrumbs for rule evaluation order would help debug flapping.

infra-bot: Experiment deployed to eng-platform/staging: autofallback-inspector-v1 toggle ON for 5% traffic.

Nikhil P: For API shape, propose a single decision envelope we can fetch: 
```
{
  "decision_id": "uuid",
  "timestamp": "iso",
  "trigger": "500_spike|latency_tail|quota_exceeded|manual_override",
  "rule_id": "string",
  "mode": "soft_cache|quiet_reject|model_fallback",
  "pre_route": "route-name@v1",
  "post_route": "route-name@v0-quant",
  "trace_id": "trace-xxx",
  "sampled_request_id": "short-id",
  "audit_link": "https://.../audit/decision_id"
}
```

Maya R: That looks good. Add estimated cost delta and an optional regression_score if we have eval telemetry for quality impact.

Carla L: UI should default to hiding cost/quality unless user expands. We can show a tiny badge: ⚠️ quality-risk 7%.

OpsOnCall: If a fallback is triggered by request quota on dedicated clusters, we need the Inspector to show which quota bucket and remaining tokens. Otherwise SRE will get paged with unclear context.

Sam W: Agreed. Also thinking about a 'why' badge in routes list: hover -> quick decision summary (last 24h samples) + link to Inspector for that route. Lightweight so console doesn't slow down.

Oliver K: Retention policy: keep full decision envelopes for 30 days, metadata (decision_id, counts) for 365. And RBAC: only users with "auditor" role can expand sampled_request payloads. That should satisfy compliance teams.

Nikhil P: We should standardize telemetry keys: fallback.trigger, fallback.rule_id, fallback.mode, fallback.decision_id, fallback.cost_delta. That makes it easy for dashboards and alerts.

Maya R: Also a dry-run toggle in UI & API that simulates the fallback without changing routing — useful to preview rollouts. button: "Preview fallback (dry-run)".

Carla L: For replay: the Inspector's replay button should call the orchestration API with `dry_run=true` and attach the original trace_id. We'll provide a signed short-lived token so replay is auditable.

OpsOnCall: Two operational asks: 1) show how many requests have been auto-fallbacked in last 5m/1h; 2) allow quick mute of noisy fallback rules from the Inspector (operator-level toggle).

Sam W: Implementation plan (rough): frontend Inspector + mini timeline card (Carla), decision-api endpoint (Nikhil), telemetry naming and retention (Oliver), dry-run/replay wiring (Maya), RBAC + audit link behavior (Ops).

infra-bot: Note: rollout toggle for inspector requires a small schema change to decision events — create migration ticket.

Nikhil P: One more API suggestion: expose `explain(decision_id, level=summary|full)` so console can call summary initially and fetch full on expand. Keeps list queries cheap.

Maya R: Good call. summary should be ~200 bytes. full can contain pointers to traces/audit payloads.

Carla L: I'll sketch the UI tomorrow and attach mocks to the ticket. Can we attach a small example response for the summary view?

Sam W: I'll open a GH issue linking responsibilities: frontend (Carla), decision-api (Nikhil), telemetry + retention (Oliver), dry-run hook (Maya), ops controls (OpsOnCall). Rough ETA: prototype in 2 weeks if infra capacity available. :rocket:

OpsOnCall: Sounds great. Please add a safety: limit replay rate per decision_id to 5/min and global replay rate to 100/min to avoid accidental storms.

Oliver K: Also add a flag to redact request text when customer tenant flag is off. We'll default to redacted.

Sam W: Done — will include those constraints in the issue. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
